icp: SquadBots engineers and customers relying on correct context recovery
buyerPain: A fixture race obscures whether changed bot instructions start a fresh session
revenueHypothesis: Reliable regression evidence prevents incorrect release decisions
objective: Make the existing context-reset regression wait for its intended pre-mutation snapshot through an existing progress event
acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce the failure on unchanged base
Use an existing observable event barrier with no sleep
Run the named regression and affected suite in a credential-free environment
rollback: Revert the isolated test-only commit; no product behavior changes

vercel.reason: Test-only fixture synchronization; no runtime or hosted product deployment

stopCondition: Verified bounded regression fix or exact timeout; do not weaken assertions or modify the separate browser-recovery commit
deliveryStatus: implemented and independently reviewed locally; publication and repository-wide release gates unresolved

verification.unchangedBase: same original regression failed in clean environment
verification.fullSuite: not rerun after fixture change; original broad run remains failed
